title: A Song of Mockery and Judgment Against Extortioners in Judah
description: The Lord proclaims woe to those who plan evil on their beds and seize fields, houses, and inheritances from their neighbors [ref:Mi 2:1-2]. Therefore the Lord plans disaster against this family, and on the day of judgment a bitter taunt will be sung: "We are completely destroyed!" The inheritance will be taken away, and no one shall cast lots for land in the assembly of the Lord [ref:Mi 2:3-5]. The leaders of the people will prevent true prophets from speaking, but the Lord accuses the people of rising up as enemies, stripping cloaks from peaceful passersby, and driving women out of their homes [ref:Mi 2:6-10]. A false prophet who promises wine and strong drink would be more fitting for this people [ref:Mi 2:11].
